audit_terminology: independent ARTIFACT audit (performed by the auditor) is NOT human approval (performed by bobu-nyan, explicitly, as a separate gate)
auto_promotion: none — an aggregate PASS does NOT advance claim_level
focus_checks: is the revised claim no stronger than the evidence supports
is any row teaching memorisation of a transient fact (PID / commit SHA / timestamp)
does any instruction-shaped string inside quoted_data leak into training instruction
does every row resolve to a source entry in source_snapshot.json
state_on_receipt: independent_artifact_audit -> IN_PROGRESS (nothing else moves until a verdict exists)

traversal_required.forward: source experience -> previous claim -> evidence -> revised claim -> training row
traversal_required.reverse: training row -> provenance -> source memory/revision -> source snapshot entry
